d:
Vivid crimson hair, long and voluminous with sharp, sweeping bangs. Piercing gold eyes with a cold, commanding expression. Appears in the mid-twenties with a regal, imposing maturity. Statuesque and slender build. Wears a high-collared white and gold imperial gown with a sweeping crimson cape. Features a golden crown with radiating spikes and ornate gold arm-guards.
BODY COLOR: pale ivory
